literature_targets.share_gc_below_1pct: 0.85-0.92 (D'Avolio 2002: 91% of names GC; Engelberg et al 2018)

MOM.signal: 12-1 momentum: long the top decile of 12-month return skipping the last month, short the bottom

SIR.signal: short interest: long the least-shorted decile (short interest / shares outstanding, as published), short the most-shorted

REV.signal: one-month reversal: long the worst decile of the last month, short the best

headline.gross_exposure: 100 % long / 100 % short of NAV, monthly rebalance
